description: This file defines the AnimatorPath class for managing a sequence of drawing points including move, line, and curve commands, used for animations in an Android project.

classes.name: AnimatorPath
classes.description: Represents a drawable path composed of move, line, and bezier curve commands, storing a sequence of PathPoint objects.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Adds a path point marking a move operation to the specified (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Adds a path point representing a straight line to the specified (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: curveTo
methods.description: Adds a quadratic bezier curve with specified control points ending at (x, y).

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Returns the collection of PathPoint objects that comprise this path.
